candidates.title: Vijay, Stalin, Edappadi Hit Ground as Madurantakam, Dharapuram Polls Near
candidates.excerpt: Former chief minister Stalin will launch his campaign at Dharapuram in western Tamil Nadu, while party leaders Udhayanidhi Stalin and Kanimozhi have already been campaigning for the bypolls in the two segments

candidates.title: 190 Delhi Parks Marked High Risk After Kalkaji Gang Rape, Only 16 Have CCTV
candidates.excerpt: The audit comes after a 17-year-old girl was allegedly gang-raped by three men at knifepoint in Aastha Kunj Park in Delhi

candidates.title: "Sit Next To Israelis In Flight": Israel Minister To NDTV On flydubai Scare
candidates.excerpt: Israeli Minister for Economy and Industry Nir Barkat dismissed suggestions that the flydubai plot was designed to strain relations between Israel and its Gulf partners

candidates.title: If there was theft, BJP’s seats would not have decreased from 303 to 240: OP Rajbhar
candidates.excerpt: Uttar Pradesh Minister Om Prakash Rajbhar criticised Opposition parties over their protest against Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar, questioning allegations surrounding the Election Commission. Other BJP leaders also attacked the Opposition, while the poll panel maintained that SIR decisions were unanimous

candidates.title: Live: Corrupt System Is Eating Up Us: CJP's Jail Bharo Aandolan
candidates.excerpt: CJP spokesperson Abhijit Dipke said he expected the Mumbai Police to cooperate with the protest and maintained that the party's agitation would remain peaceful

candidates.title: Teen gang-raped, her friend sexually assaulted near Delhi
candidates.excerpt: In a tragic event on Thursday, authorities apprehended three suspects connected to the gang rape of a 13-year-old girl in Greater Faridabad. Six youths threatened the victims as they returned from tuition classes, leading to the assault in an abandoned structure. After initially hiding the incident, the victims informed their families, resulting in a formal police complaint.

candidates.title: Gandhi Jayanti: KCR calls for peace, brotherhood and democratic struggle
candidates.excerpt: BRS president K Chandrashekhar Rao recalled Mahatma Gandhi's ideals of peaceful democratic struggle on his birth anniversary and urged people to shun divisive politics. BRS leaders KT Rama Rao and T Harish Rao also paid tribute, highlighting Gandhi's message of truth and non-violence
